rec.name: PDP Upsell / Cross-Sell Grid ("Goes perfectly with it")
rec.status: Built — launched (live theme; final layout awaiting customer confirmation)

what.text: A cross-sell block placed directly under the Add to Cart button on the product page. It has a headline ("Passt perfekt dazu" / "Goes perfectly with it") and a social-proof sub-headline ("8 von 10 Kunden kaufen zusätzlich" / "8 out of 10 customers also buy"). Below sit complementary products, each with image, title, price and its own "HINZUFÜGEN" (Add) button. The first version was a one-row carousel with small thumbnails. It became a vertical list, then a 2-column grid with larger images, with title, price and button under each image. The product list is pulled from a product metafield ("Upsell Product Listing") so each PDP can show its own products. Tiles are forced to equal width and height so long titles don't break the grid.

why.text: Shoppers who have just decided to buy are most open to adding complementary items, so showing relevant add-ons near the main CTA lifts AOV with little friction. The "8 out of 10 customers also buy" line adds social proof and normalises the add-on. Larger images, visible prices and one-click add buttons reduce effort and uncertainty. Uniform tile sizes look tidy and trustworthy and keep scanning easy. The stat is a claim to be verified with the customer (see dependencies).

how.text: Build as a section/block in the Sectionfy PDP template, placed below the Add to Cart button. Settings in the theme editor cover headline, sub-headline, product source, text color and background color. Connect the product list to a product-level list metafield ("Upsell Product Listing", type: list of products) via dynamic source so each product shows its own upsell products. Fall back to a manually chosen product list if the metafield is empty. Render a 2-column grid (2×2 for four products) on desktop and mobile: image on top, title, price, then a full-width black "Add" button. Give tiles equal width and equal height (for example CSS grid with equal rows, and a clamped or min-height title area) so differing title lengths don't break the layout. Each button adds only that product to the cart via AJAX. A separate bundle-style variant (checkboxes, auto-add with the main product) was discussed as a different feature requiring its own metafield and about 3–5 h of work, and was not confirmed.

items: Upsell products: manual picker OR dynamic source linked to a product metafield ("Upsell Product Listing")
Layout: carousel / single column / 2-column grid (iterated in the ticket; the final choice is the 2-column grid)

dependencies.text: Product metafield (list of products) "Upsell Product Listing" must be filled per product, otherwise the same fallback products appear on every PDP (this caused a customer complaint). Sectionfy-based theme with Shopify dynamic sources. The "8 out of 10 customers" claim is the customer's own copy and needs legitimate data behind it. The bundle/checkbox variant would need a separate metafield and custom logic.

items: Attach rate (orders with upsell item / orders with main product)

images.caption: First version: "Passt perfekt dazu" carousel with a single small product and Add button under the main Add to Cart.
Theme editor: Upsell settings (headline, sub-headline, product picker, text/background color) with a vertical list preview.
Customer's reference design: 2×2 grid with large images, titles and prices (the bundle-style checkbox variant that was not built).
Mobile 2×2 grid layout with image, title, price and Add button per tile.
Upsell products linked to the "Upsell Product Listing" metafield via dynamic source in the editor.
Final desktop 2×2 grid ("Oft zusammen gekauft"): equal tiles with image, title, price and black Add button.
